text.en: Dog owners praise the salon on West 4th Avenue for dependable haircuts, clean wash finishes, and precision nail trims. Multiple long-time clients note that their Labradoodles and Golden Doodles consistently receive compliments from neighbours after visits. Reviewers value the reliable quality of cuts that keep dogs looking tidy and perfectly groomed.

Reviewers emphasize the calm, patient approach shown by groomer Jen and the salon staff. Pet guardians appreciate that the team handles difficult clipping tasks smoothly without causing distress to the animal. Clients remark that the groomers display authentic affection for animals, greeting pets with gentle hugs, treats, and positive encouragement.

Owners value that Paw Prints combines pet grooming with open daycare amenities. Reviewers appreciate that dogs are allowed to lounge and play comfortably with other pets instead of waiting in crates before or after appointments. This unhurried atmosphere helps pets stay calm, relaxed, and happy during their stay in Kitsilano.

q.en: Are dogs kept in crates while waiting for pickup?

a.en: No, the facility integrates grooming with open daycare play, allowing dogs to relax without being crated.

q.en: Does the salon groom challenging or nervous dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the groomers remain calm and patient when clipping difficult dogs, keeping sessions stress-free.

q.en: Does Paw Prints offer grooming for cats?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides feline bathing, styling cuts, and nail clipping alongside dog grooming.

q.en: What breeds do clients commonly bring to the salon?

a.en: Reviewers mention regular appointments for Doodles, Yorkies, and various companion dog breeds.
